انتحرت (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرْتُ (intaḥartu) /in.ta.ħar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اِنْتَحَرْتَ (intaḥarta) /in.ta.ħar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اِنْتَحَرْتِ (intaḥarti) /in.ta.ħar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اِنْتَحَرَتْ (intaḥarat) /in.ta.ħa.rat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
